name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lower the bar to mid-chest with shoulder blades pinched, then press until the elbows are straight.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: On a 30–45° bench, lower the bar to the upper chest and press up.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: On a decline bench, lower the bar to the lower chest and press up.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Press both dumbbells up from chest level, letting them travel slightly inward at the top.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: On an incline bench, press the dumbbells from the upper chest to straight arms.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: With a slight elbow bend, open the arms wide until the chest stretches, then bring them back together.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
instructions: The dumbbell fly on an incline bench, to bias the upper chest.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Press the handles forward until the arms are straight, then return under control.

name: Incline Machine Press
instructions: Press the handles up and forward on the incline machine.

name: Pec Deck
instructions: Bring the pads or handles together in front of the chest, then open slowly.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: From high pulleys, sweep the handles down and together in front of the hips.

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
instructions: From low pulleys, sweep the handles up and together at chest height.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: A bench press on the guided bar of the Smith machine.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Keep the body in one line, lower the chest to the floor and push back up.

name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: A push-up with the hands on a bench or box, which makes it easier.

name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: A push-up with the feet on a bench, which shifts load to the upper chest.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: On parallel bars, lean forward, lower until the shoulders are below the elbows and press up.

name: Weighted Dip
instructions: A dip with added load on a belt; record the added weight.

name: Band Chest Press
instructions: Anchor the band behind you and press both hands forward.

name: Deadlift
instructions: With a flat back, push the floor away and stand up with the bar close to the legs.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: A deadlift with a wide stance and the hands inside the knees.

name: Rack Pull
instructions: A deadlift from pins or blocks at about knee height.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: From a dead hang with an overhand grip, pull until the chin clears the bar.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: A pull-up with the palms facing you.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
instructions: A pull-up with added load on a belt; record the added weight.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: A pull-up on the assistance machine; record the assistance weight, where less is harder.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Pull the bar to the upper chest, driving the elbows down, then let it rise under control.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: A pulldown with a narrow neutral handle.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: With nearly straight arms, sweep the bar from eye level down to the thighs.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinged at the hips with a flat back, pull the bar to the lower ribs.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: A barbell row where each rep starts from the floor with the torso parallel to it.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddling the bar, pull the loaded end to the chest with a flat back.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: With one hand on a bench, pull the dumbbell to the hip.

name: Chest-Supported Row
instructions: Lying chest-down on an incline bench, row both dumbbells up.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sitting tall, pull the handle to the stomach and squeeze the shoulder blades together.

name: Machine Row
instructions: Pull the handles back on the row machine, keeping the chest on the pad.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Hanging under a low bar with the body straight, pull the chest to the bar.

name: Band Row
instructions: With the band anchored in front, pull both hands to the ribs.

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold the band at chest height and pull it apart until it touches the chest.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lying across a bench, lower one dumbbell behind the head and pull it back over the chest.

name: Back Extension
instructions: On the hyperextension bench, hinge down and come back up to a straight line.

name: Good Morning
instructions: With the bar on the back, hinge at the hips with soft knees, then stand.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Lift the shoulders straight up towards the ears and lower them slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: A shrug holding a dumbbell in each hand.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Standing, press the bar from the collarbones to locked out overhead.

name: Seated Dumbbell Press
instructions: Seated, press the dumbbells from ear height to overhead.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with palms facing you and rotate them forward as you press overhead.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Press the handles overhead on the shoulder press machine.

name: Push Press
instructions: Dip the knees slightly and use the legs to help drive the bar overhead.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height, leading with the elbows.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: A lateral raise with a low pulley, one arm at a time.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise the pads out to shoulder height on the lateral raise machine.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Raise the dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height.

name: Reverse Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Hinged forward, raise the dumbbells out to the sides to work the rear shoulders.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Facing the pec deck, sweep the handles back and out.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Pull the rope towards the face, elbows high, ending with the hands beside the ears.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Pull the bar up along the body to chest height with the elbows leading.

name: Band Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand on the band and raise the hands out to shoulder height.

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: With hips high in an inverted V, lower the head towards the floor and press up.

name: Handstand Hold
instructions: Hold a handstand, against a wall if needed.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Curl the bar to the shoulders without swinging, and lower it fully.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: A curl with the angled EZ bar, which is easier on the wrists.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Curl the dumbbells up, turning the palms to face the shoulders.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Curl with the palms facing each other throughout.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Lying back on an incline bench, curl from a full stretch.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Seated, with the elbow braced against the inner thigh, curl one dumbbell.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: With the upper arms on the preacher pad, curl the bar up and lower it under control.

name: Machine Preacher Curl
instructions: A preacher curl on the machine.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Curl a bar or rope from a low pulley.

name: Band Curl
instructions: Stand on the band and curl both hands to the shoulders.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: A bench press with the hands about shoulder-width, elbows tucked.

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: With the elbows pinned to the sides, push the bar down until the arms are straight.

name: Rope Pushdown
instructions: A pushdown with the rope, spreading the hands apart at the bottom.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Facing away from the pulley, extend the rope from behind the head to overhead.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lying down, lower the bar towards the forehead by bending the elbows, then extend.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower it behind the head and extend.

name: Dumbbell Kickback
instructions: Hinged forward with the upper arm still, straighten the elbow behind you.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: With the hands on a bench behind you, lower the hips and press back up.

name: Triceps Dip
instructions: A parallel-bar dip with the torso upright and the elbows close.

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: A push-up with the hands together under the chest.

name: Machine Triceps Extension
instructions: Extend the arms against the pads on the triceps machine.

name: Band Pushdown
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and push both hands down to the thighs.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: With the forearms resting on a bench, curl the bar with the wrists only.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: A wrist curl with the palms facing down.

name: Reverse Curl
instructions: A curl with an overhand grip.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Walk with a heavy weight in each hand, standing tall.

name: Dead Hang
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms for time.

name: Back Squat
instructions: With the bar on the upper back, sit down between the hips until the thighs are at least parallel, then stand.

name: Front Squat
instructions: A squat with the bar on the front of the shoulders and the torso upright.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at the chest and squat between the knees.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: A squat on the guided bar of the Smith machine.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: With the back on the pad, lower the sled by bending the knees and press back up.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Lower the platform until the knees are well bent, then press without locking them hard.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Straighten the knees against the pad and lower slowly.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: With the back foot on a bench, lower the back knee towards the floor and stand.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
instructions: Step forward, lower the back knee towards the floor and push back to standing.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Lunge forward continuously, alternating legs; count total steps.

name: Barbell Lunge
instructions: A lunge with the bar on the upper back.

name: Step-Up
instructions: Step onto a box with one leg and stand tall, then lower under control.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Squat to at least parallel with the arms in front for balance.

name: Jump Squat
instructions: Squat down and jump, landing softly into the next rep.

name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Squat on one leg with the other held straight out in front.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Hold a seated position with the back against a wall and the thighs parallel.

name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Lean back with the knees travelling forward and the hips extended, then return.

name: Band Squat
instructions: Stand on the band with it looped over the shoulders and squat.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: With soft knees, push the hips back and lower the bar along the legs until the hamstrings stretch, then stand.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: A Romanian deadlift holding dumbbells.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
instructions: A deadlift with the legs nearly straight throughout.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hinge on one leg, letting the other rise behind, then stand.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lying face down, curl the pad towards the glutes.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Seated, pull the pad down and back under the thighs.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneeling with the ankles held, lower the body forward as slowly as possible.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
instructions: On the GHD bench, lower the torso and pull back up with the hamstrings.

name: Band Leg Curl
instructions: Lying face down with the band around the ankles, curl the heels to the glutes.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: With the upper back on a bench and the bar over the hips, drive the hips up until the torso is level.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: A hip thrust on the dedicated machine.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lying on the back with the knees bent, lift the hips until the body is straight from knee to shoulder.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: A glute bridge with one foot off the floor.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: With an ankle strap on a low pulley, kick the leg straight back.

name: Cable Pull-Through
instructions: Facing away from a low pulley, hinge and stand with the rope between the legs.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge and snap the hips forward to swing the kettlebell to chest height.

name: Band Lateral Walk
instructions: With a band around the legs, step sideways in a half squat; count total steps.

name: Donkey Kick
instructions: On all fours, drive one heel up towards the ceiling.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Push the pads apart with the outside of the knees.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
instructions: Squeeze the pads together with the inside of the knees.

name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: A side plank with the top leg supported on a bench.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Rise onto the toes as high as possible and lower to a full stretch.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Seated with the pad on the knees, raise and lower the heels.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
instructions: On the leg press with only the toes on the platform, push through the ankles.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Holding dumbbells, rise onto the toes on the edge of a step.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
instructions: Rise onto the toes on a step, one or both legs.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold a straight line from head to heels on the forearms and toes.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Hold a straight line on one forearm and the side of one foot.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lying on the back, curl the shoulders off the floor towards the hips.

name: Sit-Up
instructions: From lying, sit all the way up and lower under control.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Alternate bringing each elbow to the opposite knee; count total reps.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hanging from a bar, raise straight legs to hip height or higher.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hanging from a bar, bring the knees up to the chest.

name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lying on the back, raise straight legs to vertical and lower without touching the floor.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Seated and leaning back, rotate the torso side to side; count total touches.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: From a push-up position, drive the knees to the chest alternately at speed.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: On the back, lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back down.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: On all fours, extend the opposite arm and leg and return.

name: Hollow Hold
instructions: On the back, hold the shoulders and legs just off the floor.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneeling, roll the wheel out as far as you can hold a flat back, and pull back.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneeling under a high pulley, curl the torso down against the rope.

name: Machine Crunch
instructions: Curl the torso forward against the machine's resistance.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Standing side-on to the pulley, press the handle straight out and resist the turn.

name: Cable Woodchop
instructions: Rotate the torso to pull the handle diagonally across the body.

name: V-Up
instructions: Lying flat, lift the legs and torso together to touch the toes.

name: Toes-to-Bar
instructions: Hanging from a bar, raise the feet all the way to touch it.

name: Clean and Press
instructions: Pull the bar from the floor to the shoulders, then press it overhead.

name: Power Clean
instructions: Pull the bar explosively from the floor and catch it on the shoulders in a quarter squat.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
instructions: Squat with dumbbells at the shoulders and press them overhead as you stand.

name: Kettlebell Clean and Press
instructions: Clean the kettlebell to the rack position and press it overhead.

name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: From lying, stand up while holding a weight locked out overhead, then reverse.

name: Burpee
instructions: Drop to the floor, push up, jump the feet in and jump with the hands overhead.

name: Box Jump
instructions: Jump onto a box, land softly, stand tall and step down.

name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Crawl on hands and feet with the knees just off the floor.

name: Sled Push
instructions: Drive a loaded sled forward with the arms straight or bent.

name: Battle Ropes
instructions: Make continuous waves with the ropes for time.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
instructions: Lift the ball overhead and throw it hard into the floor.

name: Suspension Trainer Row
instructions: Leaning back on the straps with the body straight, pull the chest to the hands.

name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Run on the treadmill; record distance and time.

name: Outdoor Run
instructions: Run outdoors; record distance and time.

name: Incline Treadmill Walk
instructions: Walk on an inclined treadmill; record distance and time.

name: Walking
instructions: Walk at a steady pace; record distance and time.

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Ride the stationary bike; record distance and time.

name: Outdoor Cycling
instructions: Ride outdoors; record distance and time.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Row on the ergometer; record distance and time.

name: Elliptical Trainer
instructions: Use the elliptical trainer for time.

name: Stair Climber
instructions: Climb on the stair machine for time.

name: Ski Erg
instructions: Pull the ski ergometer handles; record distance and time.

name: Air Bike
instructions: Ride the fan bike, pushing and pulling the handles, for time.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Skip rope for time.

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Jump the feet apart while raising the arms overhead, and back, for time.

name: High Knees
instructions: Run on the spot bringing the knees to hip height, for time.

name: Swimming
instructions: Swim; record distance and time.

name: Stretching
instructions: A stretching or mobility block, recorded as time.
